mapper.insert: INSERT INTO help_request ( user_id, title, type, content, location, contact, photo, publish_time, audit_status, handle_status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{type}, #{content}, #{location}, #{contact}, #{photo}, NOW(), 1, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT h.*, u.username FROM help_request h LEFT JOIN user u ON h.user_id = u.user_id WHERE h.help_id = #{helpId}
mapper.update: UPDATE help_request SET handle_status = #{handleStatus} WHERE help_id = #{helpId}
